plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Biology, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/biology-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Biology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines grid footnotes on this page: 6 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 7 = 'See program recommendations or requirements' — those slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions; see advisor. The grid footnote numbered 3 in the 2nd semester is not defined on this page (the course-list footnote 3 concerns MATH 181 for UNR transfer) — modeled as a choice slot with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. The 4th-semester physics row is published as 'PHYS 151 or PHYS 180 and PHYS 180L' — modeled as an OR choice slot; taking the PHYS 180 path includes the 1-unit lab. Combined lecture+lab rows (BIOL 190A & 190L, BIOL 191A & 191L) are split into separate course entries totaling the published combined units. All recommended courses partially satisfy the BS in Biology at UNR. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
